# Model-load path inventory (generated by scripts/p31_inventory.py)

Static pattern scan of `horizon/`, `bench/`, `scripts/` Python. It finds *literal* load calls only; dynamic imports, shell-outs and non-Python code are not covered.

| Surface | Hits | Locations |
|---|---|---|
| hf_from_pretrained | 0 | — |
| torch_load | 0 | — |
| pickle_load | 0 | — |
| joblib_load | 0 | — |
| safetensors_load | 0 | — |
| gguf_or_onnx_load | 0 | — |
| adapter_load | 0 | — |
| tokenizer_load | 0 | — |
| remote_model_ref | 0 | — |
| yaml_unsafe_load | 0 | — |
| eval_exec_loading | 2 | horizon/runtime/artifacts.py:150, scripts/p31_inventory.py:10 |

Result: this repository contains **no model-loading code**: it never loads weights, adapters, tokenizers or inference images. The only hit is the `exec(` surface (sandboxed code execution, covered by P24-P27).
HorizonWeights therefore guards the *admission decision* for an external protected runner; the runner's actual loader must call `horizon.weights.intake.admit()` and honour DENY. That integration cannot be verified from this repository.

## Surfaces a deployment must still inventory by hand

- inference server code and its own `from_pretrained`/`torch.load` calls
- adapter hot-loading endpoints
- tokenizer/chat-template downloads at start-up
- container base images and entrypoints
- mutable remote references (`latest`, branch names, unpinned tags)
- serialization formats: pickle/torch zip, joblib, `.py` custom modeling code (`trust_remote_code`)
